verbs.name: recipe.list
verbs.description: List the built-in pipeline-manifest RECIPES — named, gated WORKFLOWS over the existing verbs (e.g. first-project, podcast-repurpose, talking-head-cleanup, screen-demo-polish, phone-clip-cleanup, social-short-bundle, area-privacy-mask, add-captions, youtube-export, tiktok-export). Each entry carries its title, description, declared params, and stage count. Pure READ: no project required, no op, no checkpoint. Pair with recipe.describe (full manifest) then recipe.run.
verbs.result: {recipes:[{name, title, description, params:[{name,type,required,default}], stage_count}]} — the discovery surface for an agent/UI choosing a recipe.

verbs.name: recipe.describe
verbs.description: Describe ONE recipe in full — its params (type/required/default/enum) and the ordered stages it will run ({id, verb, templated args, rationale, gate}). Lets an agent read EXACTLY what a recipe will do (and the per-stage success gates) BEFORE running it. Pure READ. NOT_FOUND for an unknown name (names come from recipe.list).
verbs.result: the resolved recipe {name, title, description, params:[{name,type,required,default,description,enum?}], stages:[{id, verb, args, rationale, await_job, gate}]}.

verbs.name: recipe.run
verbs.description: Run a named recipe — a declarative, gated pipeline over the existing verbs. The runner is a PURE ORCHESTRATOR (like autopilot.run / audio.cleanup_voice / comment.apply): it records NO op of its own, wraps the whole run in ONE auto-checkpoint (so it reverts in one step), dispatches each stage's verb through the normal dispatch() path (real, replay-safe ops), polls any sub-job (transcribe/render) to completion, evaluates the stage's gate (receipt checks and/or render-free state facts), and STOPS + reports on the FIRST failed verb or failed gate — handing back the checkpoint (never a silently half-applied run). args overrides the recipe param defaults (a missing required param is invalid_args naming it). policy:"dry_run" resolves + interpolates + validates and returns the PLAN WITHOUT dispatching anything (the pre-render-gate seam). run returns {job_id, checkpoint}; the clean report lands in the job result. Requires an open project.

args.description: Param overrides merged OVER the recipe defaults (e.g. {asset:"a1"}). A missing required param is invalid_args naming it.

policy.description: run (default) = execute; dry_run = resolve + interpolate + validate and return the PLAN without a checkpoint or any dispatch (the pre-render-gate seam).

rationale.description: Recorded on the run's checkpoint and threaded into each stage's op rationale (for verbs that accept one).

verbs.result: {job_id, checkpoint, recipe, stages} — the clean report lands in the job result (jobs.status): {summary_line, recipe, status: completed|failed|gate_failed, policy, stages_run, stage_results:[{id, verb, ok, op_ids, job_id?, job_result?, gate?:{pass, checks:[{name,pass,found,evidence}], state:[{fact,op,value,measured,pass}]}}], changed:DiffSummary, checkpoint, receipt_ids, restore_hint}. policy:dry_run returns the resolved plan directly (no job).

x-async-result.const: {summary_line, status, policy, stages_run, stage_results, changed, checkpoint, receipt_ids, restore_hint} via jobs.status
